SetupProfile.title: SetupProfile
SetupProfile.description: User-owned Nuvio configuration profile holding Nuvio account setup data, Real-Debrid and metadata API keys, unified AIOStreams stream hub settings, AIOMetadata provider settings, and deployment checklist state.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

profileName.description: Human-readable name for this configuration profile (e.g., Main Theater Setup).

activeProfile.description: Whether this profile is currently selected as active for the user.

nuvioEmail.description: Email address associated with the Nuvio account.

nuvioPasswordHint.description: Nuvio account password/passphrase stored privately under the owner's Firestore scope for setup convenience.

nuvioAccountCreated.description: Whether the user has completed Nuvio account registration.

realDebridApiKey.description: Real-Debrid Secret API Key configured once and inherited by all AIOStreams add-ons.

realDebridAccountReady.description: Whether the user has created and activated a Real-Debrid account.

realDebridVerified.description: Whether the Real-Debrid API key passed live API verification.

realDebridUserLabel.description: Verified Real-Debrid username and account type label.

realDebridPremiumDays.description: Remaining Real-Debrid premium days returned by live verification.

tmdbApiKey.description: The Movie Database (TMDB) API key for AIOMetadata.

tmdbVerified.description: Whether the TMDB API key passed live API verification.

mdblistApiKey.description: MDBList API key for importing custom watchlists and curated collections.

rpdbApiKey.description: Rating Poster Database (RPDB) API key for poster rating overlays.

aioStreamsInstanceUrl.description: Base URL of the AIOStreams host instance.

aioStreamsPassword.description: Encryption password created by the user for saving AIOStreams configuration.

enabledAddons.description: Enabled built-in AIOStreams add-on IDs inheriting the single master debrid config.

customStreamSources.description: User-added custom stream source URLs or IDs managed inside AIOStreams.

cachedOnly.description: Restrict streams to instant Real-Debrid cached sources only.

excludeCam.description: Filter out CAM, TS, and low-quality screener releases.

preferDolbyVision.description: Prioritize Dolby Vision and HDR10+ releases.

maxFileSizeGb.description: Maximum stream file size in gigabytes.

aioStreamsVerified.description: Whether the AIOStreams manifest URL was live-verified over HTTP.

aioMetadataInstanceUrl.description: Base URL of the AIOMetadata host instance.

rpdbPostersEnabled.description: Whether RPDB rating poster overlays are enabled in AIOMetadata.

animeCatalogsEnabled.description: Whether anime catalog rows are enabled in AIOMetadata.

aioMetadataVerified.description: Whether the AIOMetadata manifest URL was live-verified over HTTP.

nuvioMetaInstalled.description: Checklist flag: AIOMetadata installed in Nuvio.

nuvioStreamsInstalled.description: Checklist flag: AIOStreams installed in Nuvio.

nuvioOrderVerified.description: Checklist flag: AIOMetadata placed above AIOStreams in Nuvio.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

CatalogCollection.title: CatalogCollection
CatalogCollection.description: Custom media catalog or curated collection built for AIOMetadata and linked to a user's Nuvio setup profile.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

profileId.description: Document ID of the parent SetupProfile under the same user.

title.description: Display row title shown on the Nuvio home screen.

mediaType.description: Content category for this catalog or collection.

itemKind.description: Whether this entry is a dynamic Catalog row or a curated Collection.

sourceReference.description: Endpoint slug, MDBList URL/ID, Trakt list slug, or network identifier.

description.description: Short guidance or curation note for this row.

enabled.description: Whether this catalog/collection is included in the active AIOMetadata board.

sortOrder.description: Zero-based display order on the Nuvio home screen.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on each update.

/users/{userId}/profiles/{profileId}.description: Per-user isolated Nuvio setup profiles containing credentials, API keys, AIOStreams single-config settings, and AIOMetadata settings.

/users/{userId}/catalogs/{catalogId}.description: Per-user isolated AIOMetadata catalogs and curated collections associated with a SetupProfile.
